assets.produced_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent game prop for an interactive Chinese fortune-stick shaker. Make ONE empty upright red lacquer fortune cylinder, richly tactile aged burgundy lacquer and fine restrained gold cloud motifs, warm soft light from upper left, realistic dark reddish bamboo/wood rims and base. Use the reference only for material and style. Improve its silhouette into a clean straight cylinder approximately 2.4 times as tall as wide. Camera at a very slight elevated front angle; both the FULL ellipse of the mouth and its dark hollow EMPTY interior must be clearly readable. The top opening's oval height is about one third its width, with a clearly defined back rim and front lip. Full cylinder including its base visible. Center it straight vertical with a small even transparent margin, not tilted, no crop. ABSOLUTELY NO sticks or rods inside or outside, no baked-in shadows of sticks. Transparent background, no floor, no external cast shadow, no text, no hands. Photographic material quality, quiet traditional shrine aesthetic, no cartoon styling.
assets.description: Separate photographic cylinder sprite for layered fortune-stick physics

assets.produced_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE separate transparent fortune-stick game sprite. A SINGLE long thin straight rectangular bamboo fortune stick, upright vertical and seen from the front. Honey gold bamboo, subtly visible longitudinal wood fibers, slightly rounded blunt top and bottom, narrow dark right edge for real thickness, soft warm light from upper left. One discreet faded dark-red painted dash near its upper third. No letters or numbers. A rigid narrow slat, uniform width, approximately 24 times taller than it is wide. Entire individual stick isolated and completely visible, centered on a transparent background with generous transparent space on either side. No cylinder, no bundle, no extra sticks, no floor, no external shadow, no border. Photorealistic prop to be duplicated and animated as individual sticks in a burgundy lacquer fortune cylinder.
